incident-bot: PAGE: P1 - auth0-management-api errors (eu region) — automated detection: token-refresh failures spike > 60s error window. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC-7890 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Triggered for service 'authz-deps' -> escalation target: oncall-sre (alice). Case assigned 2299-EX-01.

alice (oncall-SRE): I'm on it. grabbing logs and signal graphs. setting channel as incident coordination. 

omar (eng-oncall): seeing 502/504 from Auth0 management endpoint in eu-west from our auth-proxy logs. sample:
```
2024-11-12T15:12:03Z auth-proxy eu-west req_id=abc123 POST /oauth/token -> 502 Bad Gateway upstream_resp_time=1200ms
2024-11-12T15:12:04Z auth-proxy eu-west req_id=abc124 POST /oauth/token -> 504 Gateway Timeout upstream_resp_time=30000ms
```

devin (infra): can confirm metric spike in 5xx for /oauth/token on eu cluster. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/uid/auth0-eu (alert: auth0.oauth.5xx.rate > 5% for 2m)

nina (eng-ml): user-facing: console refresh flows failing -> many clients attempt refresh, then fall back to full login which is heavy. I'm seeing ~4.2k failed refresh attempts/min across EU, roughly 2.8% of active sessions. Several enterprise customers reported console access errors.

maya (product-support): I have open tickets from ACME Inc and NovaHealth escalating now. ACME says some admin users can't reach the console (blocked). Marking high-touch. I'll prepare comms.

alice (oncall-SRE): triage: 1) confirm root cause with Auth0 2) mitigate in our stack (cache fallback / extend TTL) 3) notify customers + status. Assigning IC->alice, comms->maya, infra lead->devin.

devin (infra): proposing immediate mitigation: enable local token-cache fallback in auth-proxy and increase session grace TTL from 60s to 600s for refresh attempts to reduce user-visible 403s while upstream is flapping. Patch will be via feature-flag. rollout plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% in 10m increments.

alice (oncall-SRE): do it. post the exact patch command.

devin (infra): running canary now. command:
```
kubectl -n prod-auth-proxy set env deploy/auth-proxy TOKEN_CACHE_FALLBACK=true REFRESH_TTL=600 --record
# watch canary
kubectl rollout status deploy/auth-proxy -n prod-auth-proxy --watch
```

devin (infra): canary up at 5% (prod-auth-proxy-5) - metrics showing 72% drop in /oauth/token 5xx in the canary cohort within 90s.

system (incident-bot): note: increased error rate observed in eu-west az-1 and az-2. fallback applies per-proxy instance so canary is isolating traffic.

omar (eng-oncall): opened ticket with Auth0 via enterprise support. auth0-support-bot returned case #A0-4421. They acknowledge elevated error rates in eu-west management endpoints and are investigating routing/certificate refresh fanout. quoted message: "We are currently investigating increased error rates in our management endpoints affecting token exchange in EU; mitigations being applied."

lisa (customer-success): prepping a brief status update to post to status.redwood.com and to affected customers. draft: 
"We are experiencing degraded login and session refresh in the EU region due to a third-party provider incident. Our engineers have deployed a temporary fallback in our auth proxy to reduce user impact while the provider resolves the issue. We will update in 30 minutes or as information changes."

maya (product-support): pinging AEs for ACME and NovaHealth to give heads up and share the status draft. prepping personalized notes for the enterprise customers.

alice (oncall-SRE): next actions: 1) expand canary to 20% now 2) monitor token refresh success rate and frontend 403s 3) if stable after 10m, promote to 100% and close incident. Start a Slack thread for postmortem owner and timeline.

deploybot: rollout to 20% started by devin. rollout link: https://deploys.redwood/roll/9876

devin (infra): 20% done. aggregated metrics: token-refresh 5xx EU reduced from 4.2k/min -> 1.0k/min in canary cohort; global user-visible 403s reduced by ~65%.

auth0-support-bot: update on case #A0-4421: "We have identified a partial routing configuration error in our EU edge pool causing intermittent 5xx on management endpoints. Fix rollout started 2024-11-12T15:30:00Z. Expected full mitigation in 15-30 minutes. We will notify when resolved."

omar (eng-oncall): recommendation: keep fallback enabled and expand to 100% now to reduce customer impact. If Auth0 finishes fix early we'll revert fallback.

alice (oncall-SRE): approved. expanding to 100% now.

devin (infra): expanded to 100% - rollout complete. monitoring.

nina (eng-ml): alerting: added temporary rule to Redwood Optimize evals to flag token-refresh errors > 0.5% over 5m so we get immediate signal if the provider regress.

lisa (customer-success): status posted to status.redwood.com and emailed to subscribed customers at 15:36 UTC. copy of public message attached.

maya (product-support): ACME engineering confirms console access restored for their admins after the fallback. NovaHealth still seeing edge cases for mobile SSO but improving.

auth0-support-bot: final update: "Fix rollout completed at 2024-11-12T15:50:22Z. Error rates trending to baseline. We recommend you keep graceful fallback for 30 minutes then revert. If you see regressions reopen case."

alice (oncall-SRE): starting rollback of our temporary TTL bump and token-cache fallback in 10m as Auth0 suggests. will do a staged rollback (100% -> 20% -> 0) and monitor.

devin (infra): rollback started. commands: 
```
kubectl -n prod-auth-proxy set env deploy/auth-proxy TOKEN_CACHE_FALLBACK=false REFRESH_TTL=60 --record
kubectl rollout status deploy/auth-proxy -n prod-auth-proxy
```

devin (infra): rollback to 0% complete. metrics stable, token-refresh 5xx back to baseline. no new customer reports in the last 15m.

alice (oncall-SRE): declaring incident mitigated. IC->alice. Postmortem owner: alice. timeline notes will be collected in #postmortems and assigned to the incident-ops board.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED - P1 -> monitoring. Total duration ~40m. Customers impacted: estimated 12 enterprise accounts with partial console access interruptions; approx 4.2k failed refresh attempts at peak (EU).

maya (product-support): follow-up tasks: 1) outreach to affected customers + credit review 2) draft RCA with Auth0 notes 3) add more resilient fallback in code path to reduce blast radius next time.

nina (eng-ml): adding a permanent eval in Redwood Optimize to include token-exchange success as part of CI/regression checks for auth integrations.

alice (oncall-SRE): thanks team. will schedule a blameless postmortem and tag Auth0 findings. I'll file the incident doc and link to PD incident and the auth0 case: PD INC-7890, Auth0 A0-4421.

lisa (customer-success): I'll coordinate customer comms for tomorrow with the postmortem summary.

incident-bot: handoff note: oncall shift change at 16:00 UTC. oncall next: omar. If anything reappears, reopen and page SRE. :white_check_mark:
